dashboard_goal: Monitor attrition distribution, prioritize high-risk cohorts, and surface behavioral drivers to guide targeted interventions.

groups.label: Core Data Infrastructure
groups.description: Essential data loading, filtering, and aggregation utilities for the attrition dashboard.

artifacts.title: Customer Dataset Loader
artifacts.description: Load and parse the cleaned churn dataset (e.g., CSV/Parquet/DB) and return typed customer records.

artifacts.title: Global Filter Application Utility
artifacts.description: Apply global filters (income, card, gender, spend quartile, months on book) to an in-memory customer dataset based on query parameters.

artifacts.title: Churn Metric Aggregations
artifacts.description: Shared utilities to compute churn rate, retention rate, attrited/retained counts, and grouped churn statistics.

artifacts.title: 2D Pivot Utility
artifacts.description: Generic helper to compute 2D pivots (e.g., Income x Card) with aggregated metrics like churn rate and counts.

artifacts.title: Boxplot Statistics Helper
artifacts.description: Compute distribution summary statistics (min, Q1, median, Q3, max) for numeric columns grouped by a categorical field (e.g., churn_flag).

artifacts.title: Actionable Segment Definitions
artifacts.description: Define and evaluate pre-configured segment rules (e.g., low-income low-spend, high-income high-churn risk) and compute metrics for them.

artifacts.title: Metrics Summary Loader
artifacts.description: Load and expose correlations and other precomputed metrics from metrics_summary.json for use in the dashboard.
